This study analyses the types of disruptions, methods, goals, and research considerations in FSC. Results showed that the most common disruptions in the FSC are climatic, biological and environmental, logistics and infrastructure, and supply. Other disruptions include social and political, managerial and operational, demand, and public regulations. Regarding the actors involved in supply chain disruptions, we found that the most representatives are the environment, humanitarian actors, operative actors, international orga- nizations, population, and regulatory entities.
